segments: Eleven steps from the Dragon Shield to Nikolai. The Group 935 keycard lockdown is always the last S.O.P.H.I.A. challenge.
Keep the Guard of Fafnir / Dragon Shield available throughout the run; it is required for the egg and trophy progression.
Ray Gun Mark 3 is strongly recommended for the S.O.P.H.I.A. challenges and boss fight.
Build the Dragon Shield and keep it all run — the egg and a trophy need it.
The exact part spawn within each area is randomized. The shield is required for the egg progression and one of the silver trophies.
